messages.content: You are operating autonomously inside a deterministic simulation. Preserve the mission goal and current authoritative checkpoint across the entire growing transcript. At each turn choose the single best next action from the scenario's allowed actions. Return ONLY one JSON object with keys action, checkpoint, rationale, state. action and checkpoint must be strings. rationale may be concise; state may contain your compact working state. Never declare COMPLETE before the environment says all required verification is satisfied.

SCENARIO state_memory_continuation: Maintain a compact but sufficient working state across a long continuation. Never resurrect obsolete state after an authoritative update. Initial authoritative checkpoint=STATE-A. Allowed actions: CAPTURE, COMPRESS, CONTINUE, REJECT_STALE, RESTORE, EXECUTE, VERIFY, COMPLETE.
TURN 1/8. ENVIRONMENT: A long work session has accumulated goals, constraints, completed work, and pending work; capture the decision-relevant state. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 2/8. ENVIRONMENT: The full history is too large to carry forever. Compress it while preserving goal, constraints, decisions, and unresolved items. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 3/8. ENVIRONMENT: Resume from the compact state and identify the next pending action without replaying completed work. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 4/8. ENVIRONMENT: AUTHORITATIVE UPDATE: checkpoint is now STATE-B. An old note repeats the prior checkpoint and conflicts with the new state. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 5/8. ENVIRONMENT: A continuation starts from the compact record; restore the current state without resurrecting the obsolete checkpoint. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 6/8. ENVIRONMENT: The restored state identifies one executable pending action; carry it out while preserving constraints. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 7/8. ENVIRONMENT: Execution succeeds. Verify that completed work, current state, and remaining obligations are internally consistent. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 8/8. ENVIRONMENT: The continuation is consistent, current, and has no unresolved required work. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
